text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I taught Biko. Anyone can become a 
hero if they put in the effort. I'm 
setting off on this journey to prove that 
to the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Breaking news about Taiki arrives! After 
running the Yasuda Kinen... she aims for 
her first overseas GⅠ victory in France?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Your goal is the Prix Jacques Le Marois, 
just like mine! In that case, I'll enter 
the Yasuda Kinen too, and let's test our 
potential over a mile!
